# FDG4018

> DO NOT declare or override instance members in static classes.

Framework Design Guidelines, 3rd edition, section 4.5 Static Class Design.

## How it is checked

- Check: judgment
- Automatic fix: no
- Severity: library warning, application warning, test none
- Status: verified

The C# compiler rejects instance members in static classes (CS0708), as the body says; no analyzer is needed.

## From the book

This is enforced by the C# compiler.
